description:
Two minimal DataFlows that demonstrate how pipelines are wired, without any
domain data:

  - Pipeline Chaining Demo - a producer pipeline hands its payload to a
    consumer pipeline over the distributed event hub.
  - Scheduled Trigger Demo - a PipelineTrigger fires its pipeline on a cron
    expression.

Both run on the Mesh Adapter that System.Communication seeds
(rtId 670000000000000000000002, rtWellKnownName MeshAdapter), so no adapter
or deployment site is seeded here. Enable Communication on the tenant first, then deploy
the two DataFlows after installing - a seeded pipeline is not registered on
the adapter until its DataFlow is deployed.

Demo and training tenants only.
